title: 日本北海道本州高壓直流連線案例
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究島嶼互聯、VSC 增建與韌性規劃；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island interconnection, a VSC addition and resilience planning. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.assumptions: 本例引用 2019 新北本 VSC 的歷史額定，不表示全部北海道本州連線現況或可用容量。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uses historical ratings of the 2019 New Hokkaido-Honshu VSC link, not all current interconnection capacity or availability.

steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。與紐西蘭案例比較需求、路徑和技術年代。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「島嶼互聯方法可比較其他 HVDC，但網路強度和路徑不同。」和待排除假說「不同國家 HVDC 可直接複製全部設定。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare needs, routes and technology eras with New Zealand. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Island-link methods transfer to other HVDC cases, but network strength/routes differ.” with the hypothesis to reject “HVDC settings can be copied wholesale between countries.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：與紐西蘭案例比較需求、路徑和技術年代。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare needs, routes and technology eras with New Zealand. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 與紐西蘭案例比較需求、路徑和技術年代。
steps.observationEn: Compare needs, routes and technology eras with New Zealand.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：不同國家 HVDC 可直接複製全部設定。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: HVDC settings can be copied wholesale between countries. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.
